root_cause: The Mollie Edge Functions existed but /afsluiten still posted to a Stripe-only Netlify function that needed two Netlify secrets, and /prijzen did not state what is collected. Control and Scale rows still had direct_checkout=true although they are not published.
prevention: Netlify checkout-create and checkout-readiness only validate the published offer and call bg-mollie-checkout with the Supabase service role; the Mollie key stays in Vault. Only starter, pro and groei can be bought directly (migration). /prijzen states excl. btw, Mollie payment methods and cancellation, and carries its own correct og/twitter tags. No trial: the free entry is Frisse Blik.

evidence.runtime_status: unverified until a Mollie test payment completes end to end on production after merge and Edge Function deploy

limitations: stripe-webhook.mjs stays as an inert, unconfigured file until a follow-up removes it together with its System Map entries
Test key only until go-live; SEPA direct debit and cards must be enabled on the Mollie profile
Cancellation and plan change self-service are not built
